_source: Balancing Assessment for Legitimate Interest - Publishers, Exponential (Advertising Intelligence). Prepared on the Data Protection Network template. Signed Tim Sleath, Data Protection Officer & VP Product Management, 19th April 2018. Reviewer: Dilip DaSilva, CEO.
_note: Encoded from the document's own answers, not from what a passing assessment would look like. Where the document leaves something indeterminate, the fixture leaves it indeterminate too.

purpose.description: Monetisation of publisher websites by means of targeted advertising to their users.
purpose.controllerObjective: Our organisation depends on targeted advertising; that is our revenue stream.
purpose.thirdPartyObjective: The objectives are ours and the publishers'.
purpose.recognisedInLaw: The GDPR includes direct marketing as a legitimate interest; online advertising is not named explicitly.

necessity.importantToController: Online advertising is the purpose of the company, including for EU residents, for over 15 years.
necessity.importantToThirdParties: Data is not disclosed to other controllers, only to processors acting on our behalf.
necessity.alternativeNote: Contextual targeting exists but is stated to be commercially less effective; the company commits to switching if that changes.

balancing.connectionToIndividual: No connection save via the service provided to the website the user visits.
balancing.dataNature: Pseudonymous IP address, cookie id, user agent.
balancing.twoWayRelationship: In most cases none; most partners have no subscribers or members.
balancing.scopeCanBeReduced: Stated as not applicable: 'there are no privacy risks or harms'.

controls: Never tailor ads involving individual-specific pricing.
Never knowingly serve an ad that could be distressing.
Signatory to the NAI Code of Conduct precluding sensitive categories.
Data not shared with other controllers; access limited.

retention.profile: Indefinite while active; 90 days once stale

outcome.conclusion: On the basis of the available information, Legitimate Interest seems warranted.
outcome.role: Data Protection Officer & VP Product Management
